statement: This baseline is a consolidated current-state bootstrap. It is not historical migration history.
source_audit_date: Unknown: capture date not recorded in supplied exports
source_audit_evidence: NC-00 schema/catalog export bundle, no application row exports
transformations: Remove dump session/public-schema setup and legacy pre-containment grants/defaults
Strict CREATE replaces application IF NOT EXISTS / OR REPLACE; definitions unchanged
Direct final NC-SEC ACLs and table/sequence defaults, no historical replay
Portable catalog guards: no production identifiers/OIDs/counts/hash constants
preserved_current_behavior_future_review: Cross-season active-bracket uniqueness retained alongside per-season uniqueness.
Both master uniqueness indexes retained with differing soft-delete predicates.
Missing brackets.user_id FK; standings without season_id/unique code.
Text match-team references; cyclic seasons/master pointers; nullable legacy fields.
Current RLS design, including password_resets insert/view policies using ALL.
Function authorization shortcomings, unqualified references, absent search_path preserved; four RPCs contained by ACLs.
Current bracket_view definition/security and trigger behavior.
Three trigger-only functions retain audited PUBLIC/anon/authenticated EXECUTE.
exclusions: Application/reference rows and sequence current values
Synthetic fixtures NC-ENV-05; infrastructure/enrollment/marker NC-ENV-03; reset/provider tooling

validation.status: Offline static checks passed; live execution deferred
validation.parser: PostgreSQL parser unavailable; lexical checks only, no syntax/live validity claim
checks: Source DDL equality with only documented strict CREATE transformations
Exact security ACL statements compared with NC-SEC records
Scoped defaults and unchanged function/default/platform boundary review
Lexical statement termination and matching embedded verifier
Production identity/credential/data exclusions and file scope
Independent all-20 FK target/column-type review and view/trigger prerequisite order
corrections: Static CREATE scan limited to DDL rather than preserved PL/pgSQL IF NOT EXISTS
Mixed escaped/actual audit CSV newlines normalized without changing bodies
View/policy deparser flags aligned with audited system-view output
Extensions namespace kept qualified during catalog deparsing
Explicit C collation for portable name/ACL comparison ordering
Function REVOKE applies only to four contained RPCs; trigger-only grants preserved directly

recovery: Previous write rejected before execution; clean checkpoints, no partial files; nothing discarded
